issues: Right-edge parallax figure column still extends up under the top nav bar. At 1920x1080 the SERVICES/PRICING/... links visually sit on top of the darker top edge of the figure photo. Links remain legible because that area of the image is dark, but the nav-book-btn (GET A QUOTE) still lands over the figure. Considered borderline, not a blocker.

The three-post photo shows through behind the hero copy as a background — text is legible over the darker background overlay, but the mailboxes visually crowd/collide with the headline 'From broken box to polished welcome.' A stronger scrim (bg-slate950/70) over the mobile background image would improve readability.
